# Architecture

dragpoint is a stack. Every import goes downwards and nothing reaches up,
which is what makes each layer testable without the ones above it.

`dragpoint.tools.check_layers` enforces exactly the order below, so an
import that would break it fails the build rather than the review.

| layer | rank | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dragpoint.errors` | 0 | The exceptions dragpoint raises, and nothing else. |
| `dragpoint.units` | 1 | Length units for a shop that never settled on one system. |
| `dragpoint.geometry` | 2 | Plane geometry, in millimetres, with no dependency on anything above it. |
| `dragpoint.font` | 3 | The stroke font: glyphs, faces, and the file format they load from. |
| `dragpoint.text` | 4 | Turning a string into positioned glyphs on the plate. |
| `dragpoint.tool` | 5 | The machine side: cutters, stock and how deep to go. |
| `dragpoint.spec` | 6 | What the drawing office says it wants, before anything is worked out. |
| `dragpoint.rules` | 7 | The rules that decide whether a plate can actually be cut. |
| `dragpoint.nest` | 8 | Getting the pieces onto the sheet. |
| `dragpoint.path` | 8 | From strokes on a plate to a program the machine can run. |
| `dragpoint.post` | 9 | Writing the finished toolpath in whatever language the machine speaks. |
| `dragpoint.compiler` | 10 | Putting the layers together into something a machine can run. |
| `dragpoint.draw` | 11 | Drawings of a plate, for people rather than for machines. |
| `dragpoint.estimate` | 11 | How long it takes and how much stock it eats. |
| `dragpoint.report` | 12 | Paperwork: what goes to the machine alongside the program. |
| `dragpoint.cli` | 13 | The command line. |
| `dragpoint.tools` | 14 | Checks and generators that run over the checkout. |

## What is in each layer

- **`dragpoint.geometry`** `arc`, `box`, `nearness`, `point`, `stroke`, `transform`
- **`dragpoint.font`** `compose`, `face`, `glyph`, `library`, `parse`, `write`
- **`dragpoint.text`** `fit`, `layout`, `sequence`, `shape`, `style`, `wrap`
- **`dragpoint.tool`** `cutter`, `life`, `material`, `passes`
- **`dragpoint.spec`** `feature`, `job`, `load`, `plate`, `sheetload`
- **`dragpoint.rules`** `batch`, `check`, `fitment`, `legibility`, `milling`, `process`, `report`
- **`dragpoint.nest`** `shelf`
- **`dragpoint.path`** `cut`, `lead`, `order`, `plan`
- **`dragpoint.post`** `base`, `iso`, `marker`, `plotter`
- **`dragpoint.compiler`** `cutout`, `drill`, `job`, `plate`, `settings`
- **`dragpoint.draw`** `dxf`, `sheet`, `specimen`, `svg`
- **`dragpoint.estimate`** `cycle`, `setups`
- **`dragpoint.report`** `setup`, `traveller`
- **`dragpoint.cli`** `common`, `crib`, `font`, `job`, `main`, `options`, `pack`, `plate`
- **`dragpoint.tools`** `build_architecture`, `build_commands`, `build_crib`, `build_rules`, `check_docstrings`, `check_examples`, `check_face`, `check_layers`, `check_naming`, `check_tests`, `check_wiring`, `generate`, `release_check`, `smoke`, `support`
